review_method: Individually opened and visually inspected each of the 64 generated PNG files with view_image.
scope: Visual readability and screenshot assertions only; no native app launch, native input, IME, VoiceOver, or performance acceptance.
criteria_checked: all 4 phase/status states present and visible in top/bottom frame pairs
pending Save action appears disabled while pending message and Resolve fixture action are visible
failed state preserves Studio input and exposes Retry save
light/dark and standard/increased type scale retain legibility
scrollbars indicate top and bottom positions; bottom content is reachable
no inspected screenshot showed clipping or occlusion of checked text/actions
